business.name: Starlight Coffee House
business.tagline: Handcrafted coffee, ready when you are
business.about: Starlight Coffee House roasts every bean in small batches and pulls every espresso shot by hand. Order ahead from your phone and your drink is waiting at the pickup shelf — hot, iced, or exactly how you like it.

hero.headline: Coffee, ready in 10 minutes
hero.text: Small-batch roasted espresso, buttery pastries and a pickup shelf with your name on it — ordered from your phone in under a minute.

promo.title: Starlight Rewards
promo.text: Every 10th drink is on us. Free to join, no card needed — just your phone number at the counter.

seo.description: Starlight Coffee House Seattle — handcrafted espresso, cold brew, matcha and fresh pastries. Order ahead online, ready in 10 minutes. Free rewards program.
